messages:
maya: Heads up — tainted-cert detector flagged ap-south LB talking to eu-west services; clients see `tls: handshake failure` after rotator ran. Anyone on-call?

alex: looking — logs show `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` on egress to eu-west-proxy. snippet:
```
2026-03-21T10:12:05Z proxy1 tls: handshake failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (subject: CN=redwood-internal; SAN=[service.eu-west.internal old.example])
```

liam: @maya @alex could be stale CA chain in keystore or RBAC preventing keystore read in ap-south. Did rotator upload the full chain to secrets? rotator-bot, status?

rotator-bot: cert_upload: success -> secret/serv-cert-ap-south updated; chain_length=2; uploaded_at=2026-03-21T10:08Z; note='includes SAN old.example'

sofia: Audit logs for that upload look missing in SIEM for ~20m window. audit-bot, any ship retries?

audit-bot: :warning: logship_delay detected for cluster=ap-south; last_sent=2026-03-21T10:09Z, queued=45 events; retrying to kafka-topic `redwood-audit` now.

maya: KMS decrypt attempts? I saw `AccessDenied` in KMS logs earlier.

alex: KMS IAM delta: `proxy-keystore-reader` lost `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.decode` earlier after a service-account rename; explains `AccessDenied` on unwrap. Confirmed with `gcloud kms decrypt` which returns 403 for sa:proxy-keystore.

liam: OK plan: 1) restore iam binding for sa:proxy-keystore -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter 2) rotate keystore secret to force reload 3) reingest audit events once logship backfilled

sofia: +1. I'll trigger backfill: `audit-backfill --from 2026-03-21T09:50 --to now --clusters=ap-south` and post progress. Also adding canary to verify mTLS handshakes to eu-west via curl: `curl --cert /tmp/serv.pem --key /tmp/serv.key https://proxy.eu-west/_health`

maya: executing step 1 now. ping when binding restored.

alex: binding restored (2026-03-21T10:25Z). Rotator-bot, can you reupload chain without old SAN?

rotator-bot: reissue_request accepted; issuing short-lived cert w/ SAN service.eu-west.internal only; ETA 30s.

maya: reloaded keystore on proxy pods: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/proxy-ap-south` done.

sofia: audit-backfill progress: 10% queued->sent. audit-bot shows resend success for `cert_upload` events.

liam: after restart, handshakes are green for canary. `curl` returns 200 and mTLS completed. Monitoring for 10m.

maya: postmortem notes — root cause: IAM binding removal led to failed KMS unwrap -> rotator uploaded chain with incorrect SAN/ordering, plus audit logship lag delayed detection. Action items: add RBAC monitor, add KMS binding lint to deploy, ensure rotator validates SANs and CA ordering, increase logship retry window. I'll file JIRA.

alex: filing JIRA: SEC-4521

sofia: tagging ops and SRE to watch replication. :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: audit events backfilled and acked by SIEM (topic offset 98765).
